caption_recommended:
long distance makes you miss the boring things.

not just dates.
not just trips.

the ruined dinner.
the board-game fight.
the cab being late and both of you pretending to be annoyed.

maybe closeness is not always grand romance.
maybe it is ordinary time with you.
caption_alt: Send this to the person you do not only miss on special days. You miss wasting a normal Tuesday with them.
alt_text: Illustrated carousel slide 1: Aachu and Zuv are apart in two soft phone-lit corners, each holding a phone, with tiny imagined ordinary scenes beginning to appear between them; distance is the obstacle, not the aesthetic.

Illustrated carousel slide 2: Inside the imagined shared room from the chat, Aachu and Zuv stand at a tiny kitchen counter with flour, a messy pot, and two phones nearby; Aachu is animated about the plan and Zuv joins the bad idea with a warm amused reply.

Illustrated carousel slide 3: Aachu and Zuv sit across an imagined board-game table with dice, tiny colored tokens, and exaggerated competitive faces; Zuv teases gently about her invented rules while still clearly wanting the whole scene with her.

Illustrated carousel slide 4: Rainy imagined pickup scene: Aachu and Zuv wait under one umbrella beside a small cab-app phone screen; instead of frustration, both look quietly relieved, and Zuv's reply admits he wants the extra minutes too.

Illustrated carousel slide 5: Final warm-paper room where the earlier kitchen, board-game, and cab icons soften into one ordinary shared evening; Aachu and Zuv sit close with phones lowered, proving the point is not the plans but wanting normal time together.
